newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - No movement in after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - No movement in after hours.

text.p: Traders said on Wednesday a lack of major news and the summer doldrums led to no activity after hours.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 52,800 shares compared to 5,700 shares. There was no session twovolume compared to 4,153,800 shares on Tuesday, the NYSE said.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
